title: Story premise ENT066: The Four Rotations Portrait
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: The address is a face with the wrong way up. Takeaway/theme: Orientation can make an intended pattern easier to recognize.
description: A courier must identify a face on an oddly arranged tile, but it looks like scattered marks at first. They rotate the same tile by quarter turns; at the third orientation two marks read as eyes and a curve as a smile, matching the recipient, who has been standing sideways beside them.
